profile.text: Zima, leader of the Ursus Student Self-Government Group, has served as a combat squad leader since joining Rhodes Island and recently contributed to the establishment of our Grypherburg branch. Her skills have improved considerably through both training and field experience, giving her a mature combat style that is all her own. She currently participates in Rhodes Island's operations in Ursus as a guard operator.
